rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit the following for FAA review:

1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with an infectious disease specialist or cardiologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam.

It should include a summary of the history of the condition or diagnosis; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); clinical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment and plan (prognosis); and follow-up.

2. Echocardiogram (Echo). Copies of a 2- D and Doppler flow study report performed no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam.

3. Other testing: Any deemed clinically necessary and already performed by the treating physician.

4. Hospital records: History and Physical (H&P), operative notes, and discharge summary (if applicable).
